title: Read the word marks
description: A, U and D mean Approved, Unknown and Disapproved. Only differing Analyze texts results show an outcome cue and PanGloss line: ≠ with a solid underline for a new or different reading, ∅ with a dashed underline for no parse, and ◖ with a dotted underline for a stopped search. Staged means a choice is waiting for Apply to FieldWorks project.

steps.approved-agrees: A marks the approved FieldWorks reading. PanGloss built the same reading, so no decision is needed; matching results have no outcome mark or PanGloss line. A, U and D mean Approved, Unknown and Disapproved.
steps.unknown-agrees: U means the reading is stored but not yet approved. PanGloss built the same reading, so there is no outcome mark or PanGloss line. Approve changes U to A.
steps.unknown-staged: The Staged note records a choice waiting for Apply to FieldWorks project. Undo removes it.
steps.no-stored-new-reading: The dashed mark means FieldWorks has no reading stored. A solid ≠ and underline mark the new reading PanGloss found.
steps.disapproved-conflict: D marks the stored reading as Disapproved. PanGloss still builds it, so the reading conflicts with that opinion.
steps.no-parse: There is no reading stored in FieldWorks, and PanGloss found no complete reading.
steps.capped: PanGloss stopped before finishing its search. The dotted ◖ and underline mark the unfinished search; other readings may still exist.
steps.word-list-results: The Word list shows the parsed wordforms for the selected Text.
